links.title: Edison Township Health Department Retail Food Plan Review Application
links.summary: Mandatory sanitary blueprint review for restaurants, commercial kitchens, cafes, and bakeries prior to construction or alteration.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP HEALTH DEPARTMENT - RETAIL FOOD PLAN REVIEW (CHAPTER 24 NJ SANITARY CODE)
1. PLAN REVIEW SUBMISSION: Two (2) sets of dimensioned scaled floor plans showing food preparation areas, 3-compartment dishwashing sinks, dedicated handwashing sinks (within 25 feet of work areas), mop sinks, and food refrigeration must be submitted at least 30 days prior to construction.
2. EQUIPMENT SPECIFICATIONS: All commercial cooking, refrigeration, and hot-holding units must be NSF or equivalent ANSI accredited sanitation rated.
3. GREASE INTERCEPTOR: Commercial kitchen wastewater lines must route through an appropriately sized automatic grease recovery device or grease trap.
4. FOOD PROTECTION MANAGER: Proof of at least one active full-time Certified Food Protection Manager (ServSafe or ANSI equivalent) must be submitted.
5. SUBMISSION DESK: Submit completed package with plan review fee to Edison Township Health Department, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817. Telephone: (732) 248-7285.

links.title: Edison Township Farmers Market Vendor Application Packet
links.summary: Sanitation rules, temperature logs, handwashing station requirements, and permits for temporary and open-air food vendors.
links.content:
EDISON HEALTH DEPARTMENT - TEMPORARY & FARMERS MARKET VENDOR RULES
1. TEMPERATURE INTEGRITY: All cold TCS items (dairy, meats, prepared salads) must be maintained at or below 41°F. Mechanical refrigeration or insulated coolers with drained ice packs required.
2. HANDWASHING STATIONS: Temporary vendor stalls preparing open food must feature a minimum 5-gallon insulated water container with free-flowing spigot, pump soap, disposable towels, and catch bucket.
3. SUBMISSION ROUTING: Applications must be submitted at least 14 business days prior to market date to Health Department Licensing Desk.

links.title: Edison Health Department - Vital Statistics Certified Copies Application (REG-37)
links.summary: Official application to obtain certified copies of Birth Certificates, Death Certificates, and Marriage Licenses registered in Edison Township.
links.content:
EDISON TOWNSHIP VITAL STATISTICS (FORM REG-37)
1. ELIGIBILITY: Certified copies with raised municipal seal are issued only to the subject, parent, legal guardian, spouse, child, grandchild, or legal representative with valid government photo ID.
2. INTAKE ROUTING: Submit application in person or by mail to Office of Vital Statistics, Health Department, 100 Municipal Blvd, Edison, NJ 08817. Fee: $25.00 for first copy, $2.00 each additional copy.
